primary_endpoint: Mean change from baseline in ALT at Week 12.
efficacy_outcome: Mean ALT change: placebo −13.85 U/L, EDP-305 1 mg −23.76 U/L, and EDP-305 2.5 mg −26.14 U/L. Reported p-values were 0.0495, 0.3039, and 0.2130; the source does not specify which comparison corresponds to each value.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: placebo 1/24, EDP-305 1 mg 1/55, and EDP-305 2.5 mg 0/53; no deaths in any group.
